notes.title: FPS Maze Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here comes the anticipated monthly update!


This update brings you FPS maze gameplay. This game mode was well received in the mobile version and many players were asking for it, so we have ported it to the PC version, and really hope you guys enjoy it!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/457ac9f636e0b448781e19e8584a96b10bb279b1.png[/img]


We have also added some new skins, which can be exchanged with new currency obtained in the new maze game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/2b74edca71a3f23f206d08ef738e2ab93e1f8b98.png[/img] 

Hope you enjoy this update, and see you next month!

notes.title: Aquatics are storming into ARBS!!!
notes.content:
Welcome back everyone after a long break!

Today we're bringing you a new set of creatures that a lot of you have been asking for since the beginnig of ARBS! Yes, today we're finally adding aquatic animals to the game!

This update will add 4 new water units:

- Salmon
- Piranha
- Great White Shark
- Orca

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/e93b481d25e3340718e767042062a068815f1166.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/bf7407bf1094fcb3b4b0a6147d5e1c293cd31121.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/caa9304bd618fafc70302d4f6fb5450fc0330c26.jpg[/img]

We've also added an empty water map and a filled water map with coral reef. You can actually build your own water maps with corals if you wish to!

Another marine unit will be added to ARBS in two weeks time in the last update of the year so stay tuned!

We really hope you enjoy these new additions to the game so have fun!

notes.title: Battle Robots have arrived in ARBS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

For this week's update, we've decided to go a bit more robotic and so we've added some cool new things for you to play with in the Unit Creator!

- new robotic bases
- robotic parts
- flames as decorations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/9ee42e0422cfbba3849278cae60a92e8e9484ca0.png[/img]

You can now hold down the Z key for slower and more accurate rotation and scaling. This should be quite useful for those of you who love creating awesome creatures using the Unit Creator!

And lastly, we fixed the issue with deleting things inside the carnivore heads.

Have fun with the new features and we'll see you in two weeks' time for a special Halloween update!

notes.title: Skeleton dino parts in the Unit Creator!
notes.content:
Hello again!

In this update, we've decided to add some new stuff to the unit creator. You can build skeleton dinosaurs now with some cool new skeleton dino body parts:

- skulls of carnotaurus, T-Rex, triceratops, sauropod
- theropod skeleton torso
- theropod skeleton base, triceratops skeleton base, sauropod skeleton base
- two skeleton dino tails

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cbbd1deab44888229f69fd17175122c2d3553d99.png[/img]

We've also added some extra skins for Goro the giant!

Have a great time with ARBS and see you again in 3 weeks!

notes.title: Giant Praying Mantis and Plasma Cannons!
notes.content:
Greetings animal revolters!

This week we have some seriously cool new things for you to play with!

First please welcome a new mighty addition to the giant invertebrates, the giant praying mantis!

Two new powerful weapons have been added to the unit creator:

- Lightning Gun
- Plasma Cannon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/aa94d10c99e4e048d4be7af424cd5e9020d47821.png[/img]

For fans of Godzilla you can now use the Plasma Beam T-Rex head which can both bite and shoot plasma beams! 

We've noticed that some people still don't know you can use ctrl-z/ctrl-y to undo and redo changes. For this reason we've added the undo/redo buttons to the top menu to make it more obvious that you can undo any unintended changes.

And lastly, the unit creator now has the parasaurolophus torso that you can use in your creations.

Have fun!

notes.title: Ogre Lord joins the infernals!
notes.content:
Hello lovely people!

The last few weeks we've been focusing on the unit creator and no new units were added but today we finally have a new beast for you to play with. Please welcome the Ogre Lord to the infernals faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/7226f9c4ee3a6b52a14f5a70b9c97571e6c3c0cc.png[/img]

- Herbivore dinosaur heads
- Herbivore dinosaur tails
- Modern mammals bases
- Modern mammals heads

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/5e78706ad22b57e34914ad9986f6d479a9c61d34.png[/img]

We hope you have a great time with these new additions to the game!

notes.title: Carnivore dino parts added to the Unit Creator!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Have you ever dreamt about playing around with a three-headed T-Rex? Well, now you can! We've added some cool new things to the Unit Creator for you to try out!

- new attachable carnivore dinosaur heads. They bite!
- carnivore dinosaur bases
- carnivore dinosaur torsos
- tails and claws added to the Limbs section
- new humanoid bases
- new humanoid heads
- new humanoid torsos

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/fe597471f714e92634dda6b48c6b17eb19359d77.png[/img]

Looks like most people didn't notice it from the last update but for animal bases, you have 3 different AIs to pick from, which are not the same as the usual AIs for animals.

We can't wait to see what cool monsters you can create out of those new parts! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Unit Creator is here!
notes.content:
Hello again!

This week we have added some amazing new features to the game and you're going to absolutely love it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/330f80b529e2f93f2f1a64786d5a9e5ce2adf377.png[/img]

Firstly, we have added a new section to the units selection menu called Unit Creator. All the attachable weapons, armor, and decor will go into this new section. On top of that, we have added four new sub-sections called animal/robotic bases, torsos, and heads. This basically means you can create new units from scratch now! For now, we only have humanoid animal bases, torsos, and heads but more will be added in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/d8a6292f70035ffe17408cdfd88041ca9b84bfe0.png[/img]

A second big feature we've introduced is the ability to attach things to dynamic weapons like tentacles, punchers, or hammer hands. So for example you can attach dynamite to a boxing glove to pack a truly explosive punch! Or add some extra spikes to a tentacle for extra damage. You can even add tentacles to other tentacles, there are no limits now!

Some other new things which have been added:
 - helmets 
 - new spikes 
 - blades
 
Other minor fixes and changes:
 - any bumped-up animal stats are now shown in red. If any attached weapon has an attack multiplier not set to one then a warning will be shown
 - fixed the bug with venom doing excessive damage to animals with increased health
 - you can use the arrow keys now to move the camera
 - small animals with massively increased health are no longer insta-killed by for example a T-Rex

notes.title: Swarming in!
notes.content:
Hello again!

We have some cool new things for you in this week's update. Firstable, please welcome a new addition to the giant invertebrates faction, the swarm bug!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/82cb802643bc7f1afbf3cb90a5d291ab3d829b93.png[/img]

- in the attachable decor section, we've added eyes, hats and sunglasses

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/a7575de84a740eda1ab6d6d9440cc44df263b791.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: New monstrous reptiles!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've added two new members to the reptile faction. Please welcome the poisonous Komodo Dragon and the bone-crunching Purussaurus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/bf7829ace4b418bac7b0b61775d7b6c0b66cd3f5.png[/img]

If you enjoy building maps then we've got some new things for you to try out:
- new building block colours
- new flags
- new fences

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/8df519e9b13ca4da3b8c20ad86720fec540bc9c1.png[/img]

We've also added some extra filled maps for you to play around with.

Lastly, we've implemented a much-requested feature, which is the ability to redo and undo your actions with CTRL-Z and CTRL-Y. No more annoying and irreversible deletions you didn't intend!

notes.title: Hellhound and more attachable weapons!
notes.content:
Hello again!

At long last we're introducing a new creature to ARBS! Please welcome the fiery Hellhound to the infernals faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f5153d0d0bde565f7967a584af5defcb27dee07b.png[/img]

We've also added a few new things for attachable weapons:
- two new armor types
- a new category called organic weapons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b17cd46cd5762e55aa3c67bd28a53317d0d4b21e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/0af7e6d2fa3be7af391bfd9a74de84e196305936.png[/img]

For performance reasons we've added an option to stop the weapons/armor detaching from an animal after death. You can do this by going to the map settings (Top right corner icon in the sandbox).

notes.title: The dead have arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's almost Halloween time so we're bringing you some awesome new content in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/cd68b63119d26247fff676389c1365302ea826ba.png[/img]

We've added a new faction called the Infernals with three brand new units! Please welcome the Skeleton Warrior, the Saber Ghoul and a truly powerful addition, Kozarog the Demon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/680d52bd3bebe62a10beeb7ed65f3aee38f72414.png[/img]

There is also a new campaign called "Dead Rising" which pits you against the new creatures so give it a go!

We've also added quite a few other things:
 - new landscape maps in the sandbox including an extra large grassland map. 
 - new leafless trees.
 - new cemetery building blocks which includes tombstones and various bones.
 - new triangular building blocks and a new prefab called Mausoleum.

Two quality of life updates:
 - you can change teams now using the number keys on your keyboard.
 - holding the space bar will accelerate your camera movement.

With the US presidential elections fast approaching we thought it would be cool to release a little tongue in cheek mini-update this week!

notes.title: Hill Giant is here! Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus re-mastered!
notes.content:
Hello animal revolters!

In this week's update we have quite a few cool new additions!

Firstly, please welcome a new member of the fantasy faction, the Hill Giant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/2e7039f1cab53ac4c7294158384c82b3c016af34.png[/img]

The models for Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus have been re-mastered and their AIs enhanced. You will notice Titanoboa and Therizinosaurus are much more accurate with their attacks now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/c91b8ef92cc63430fff1c0d4ab83c92cf6978381.png[/img]

A new weapon has been added for the FPS Avatar to use, the Pulse Blaster! This little gem can do some real damage so check it out in the two new maps added to the FPS campaign!

And finally, a whole new campaign called "Fantastic Beasts" has been added, which pitches units from the fantasy and reptile factions against other creatures.

Bug fixes:
 - Fixed issue with FPS avatar shooting itself
 - Fixed issue with cursor not locking to one screen

Have fun guys!

notes.title: Gorgon and Werewolf are here to rock and roll!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

1. In this update we're introducing two units to the fantasy faction: Gorgon and Werewolf!
We also added the Giraffe to the modern mammals faction.

2. We did a bit of performance optimisation for this release so you should see things running a little more smoothly now with a higher frame rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/e6c62d017c1a57c15c86177e084c0af289e4fb59.png[/img]

3. Palm trees have been added plus the Colorado blue spruce!

4. More bushes have been added.

5. We improved the locking logic for building blocks so it should be much easier to construct things now. Even building blocks with different scales should lock properly. As a reminder, to change the scale of the building blocks press Alt and mouse scroll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/8e3227141f9fa214ca5360e410f9e0957b4150e6.png[/img]

notes.title: June 26th, 2020 update!!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/b4b89573947e12c53680b0dccdffb4477adc90ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36435152/f059cd847af17fa5b0111d20437ab173bea1eb3f.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyone! We hope your summer has been great so far!

Here's a summary of new things for this update which we can't wait for you to try out:

1) Path Finding - you can enable path finding in the map settings now! That's right, the animals will be able to avoid obstacles now which means you can create some really cool battles involving buildings, rocks, trees and many other types of objects!

2) Commando Bo can be controlled in first and third person view! We'll add this functionality for other animals in the following weeks.

3) Try the new mini campaign with Commando Bo which teaches you how to go into first/third person mode.

4) Building blocks were dynamic before but now you can mark them as static so you don't have to worry about gravity pulling them down! Once set as static, the building block cannot be moved. This could be useful if you want the animals to be able to do path finding while walking on buildings. You can also create some really intricate structures now and not have to worry about the blocks falling down!

5) You can scale anything now by holding the "ALT" key and mouse scrolling! Scaling animals will lead to strange behaviour so we don't recommend that. Use it for scaling things like trees, rocks, building blocks and so on. 

6) You can add wind effect for trees in the map settings. You'll see the tree leaves weaving with the wind.

7) More rocks have been added and also more filled maps for you to play around with!

8) The cursor now disappears during battle if you are in the free camera rotation mode.
